# Platform docs

**For labs-platform maintainers. App builders can ignore this folder** — nothing
here is needed to build, run or deploy an app from the template.

| Doc | What it is |
|---|---|
| [KEYCLOAK-REGISTRAR-SETUP.md](KEYCLOAK-REGISTRAR-SETUP.md) | One-time setup of the `labs-portal-registrar` service account and its shared SSM credentials, which every app's deploy uses to register its Keycloak redirect URIs |
| [COST_TAGGING_PROMPT.md](COST_TAGGING_PROMPT.md) | Self-contained agent prompt for bringing cost-allocation tagging to systems that were **not** built from this template |
